Implemented sequential FIFO pending subagent correlation in resolveActorIdentity. invoke_subagent tracks pending workers/reviewers; child conversations matched by identity evidence; ambiguous multi-candidate fails closed to UNKNOWN.
UNKNOWN actor fails closed on workspace writes AND control-plane writes (ROLE_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED).
Reviewer blocked from ALL writes including control-plane. Binds from pending subagent list with REVIEWER role.
Fixed flash-high-worker -> flash-worker in fidelity.mjs EXPECTED_ROUTES and routing policy.
Orchestrator run_command for arbitrary commands -> ORCHESTRATOR_UNVERIFIED_COMMAND_PROHIBITED. DIRECT_ACTION allows script execution.

pre-invocation-guard.mjs bootstraps role-bindings.json and state.activeRole=ORCHESTRATOR on first invocation if conversationId is present.
